1. The petitioner filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act 1989, seeking compensation of Rs.25,00,000/- for the injures sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 01.03.2019.

. It is the case of the petitioner that, on 01.03.2019 at about 12.45 p.m., within the jurisdiction of Rajanakunte Police Station, near Rajanukunte HP Petrol Bunk, Bengaluru - Doddaballapura Road,
when the Petitioner was riding the unoffending Bajaj Pulsar Motor Cycle bearing Reg.
No.KA-43-V-4946, at that time the accused/ Respondent No.1 drove the offending Auto Rickshaw bearing Reg. No.KA-05-AD-0643 from Rajanukunte and in order to over take one vehicle, he drove the same in a high speed, rash or negligent manner so as to endangering human life and dashed against unoffending BMTC Bus bearing Reg. No.KA-57- F-2882 which was coming on its opposite direction and thereafter dashed against the said unoffending Bajaj Pulsar Motor Cycle
, as a result the Petitioner/rider fell down and sustained grievous bleeding injuries on his head, right leg and foot.
Thereafter Petitioner was shifted to Rajmahal Vilas Hospital, wherein he took treatment as inpatient.
In this regard the RW-1/driver of the unoffending BMTC Bus has lodged complaint before the Rajankunte police station.

Accordingly, a case was registered in their Crime No.25/2019 and prepared F.I.R. for the offence punishable under sections 279, M.V.C.No.913/2021 4 SCCH - 7 337 &
338 of IPC and submitted to the jurisdictional judicial Magistrate and the superior officers and investigation was taken up by the investigating Officer.
3.

Further it is contended that, prior to the alleged accident the Petitioner was hale, healthy and he was aged about 55 years and he was working as Farmer and milk Vender and earning an income of more than Rs.30,000/- p.m.
Due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident he has lost his income and future prospective life, happiness, and earning capacity and become disabled and dependent.
The alleged accident is occurred due to fault and negligence act of the driver of the offending Auto bearing Reg.No.KA-05-AD-0643 and driver of bus KA-57-F-2882.

Hence Petitioner filed the present claim petition for seeking compensation.
4. In response to the notice, respondent No.1 to 3 have appeared through their respective counsel and filed written statements.

. In the written statement of respondent No.1, he has admitted that he is the RC owner of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle and denied the petition averments in part including age, avocation,
income and negligence attributed against the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle and contended that he is possessing valid and effective driving licence and the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle was duly insured with Respondent No.3/Insurance company and any liability, i.e., fastened on him would have to be indemnify by the Respondent No.3 and sought for dismissal of the claim petition.

6. In the written statement filed by the Respondent No.2, it has admitting the ownership of the unoffending BMTC Bus bearing registration No.KA-57-F-2882 and by denying the petition averments and contended that, alleged accident occurred due to negligence and fault on the part of the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw himself and there is no such negligence or fault on the part of the driver of the said unoffending BMTC bus, as such Respondent No.2 is not liable to pay any compensation to the petitioner.
Further it is denied the age, income and occupation of the deceased and expenses incurred towards medication and other charges as alleged.
Further respondent No.2 contended M.V.C.No.913/2021 6 SCCH - 7 that, the compensation claimed by the Petitioner is highly excessive, exorbitant and imaginary.
Hence, on all these grounds, the respondent No.2 prayed for dismissal of claim petition.

Further it is contended that the insured vehicle is not involved in the accident.
The insurer liability is subjected to validity of the DL, permit, FC and other documents as per the law.
Further it is alleged that there is no compliance of provision under Section 134(C), 158 of M.V. Act.

Further it is contended that the alleged accident is occurred due to sole negligence and fault of the driver of the unoffending BMTC Bus and petitioner and no fault of the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle.
As such the insurance company is not liable to pay any compensation and in order to get compensation the Petitioner has constrained to filed the present claim petition.

Further it is denied that the age,
income and occupation of the Petitioner and the petition is false and M.V.C.No.913/2021 7 SCCH - 7 frivolous in the eye of law and the quantum of compensation claimed by the claimants is exorbitant and reserves the right u/s.170 of M.V. Act., and violated terms and conditions of the insurance policy.
Hence sought for dismissal of the claim petition.

On going through the prosecution papers, FIR, mahazar, Wound Certificate and Charge Sheet and the evidence of PW-1 and RW-1 are specific to the effect that, the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle/accused/ Respondent No.1 is the reason for the said incident and at his instance,

The evidence of Pw.1 &

At the same time, it has come out in evidence that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle and fault of the accused.
Matters being so, the acts of the accused person clearly constitute the offences punishable under sections 279, M.V.C.No.913/2021 25 SCCH - 7 337 and 338 of IPC.

Thus because of such negligent act of the accused/driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle, it resulted in the injuries of the innocent man/Petitioner aforesaid, as he/accused drove the said offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle very rashly or negligently on the spot.
Therefore, the alleged accident occurred due to the fault of the accused/driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle.

As such the Petitioner is entitled for compensation under the head of pain and suffering, mental agony, medical expenses, special diet, conveyance, loss of future income due to disability, loss of amenities and loss of income during laid up period and prays to award the compensation as prayed in the petition.

26. On the other hand the learned counsel for Respondents contended that even though the Petitioner claimed that his earning was about Rs.30,000/- p.m., the same is not M.V.C.No.913/2021 26 SCCH - 7 established by the claimant by producing the documents.
Since the Petitioner has not established his income, he is not entitled for compensation towards such prospects and hence prays dismissal of the petition.

27. The petitioner contended that as on the date of the accident he was aged about 55 years and the petitioner relied on the Ex.P.5/wound Certificate of the Petitioner, wherein the age of the Petitioner is shown as 55 years.
Hence it is clear that as on the date of the accident the Petitioner was aged about 55 years.
Hence the age of the Petitioner is considered as 55 years.
28. It is not in dispute that the Petitioner sustained injuries in the road traffic accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle by its driver/accused.

In the instance case the petitioner claimed that he was working as Farmer and Milk Vendor and earning an income of more than Rs.30,000/- p.m., But he has not produced any documents to prove his actual income.
In the absence of proof of income the notional income as to be assessed.
As per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority, for the accident taken place in the year 2019, the notional income of the Petitioner taken at Rs.13,250/-.

. In the chief examination of PW-2/Dr.K.S.Swamy Orthopedic Surgeon at Raj Mahal Vilas Hospital, deposed that in the alleged road traffic accident the petitioner has sustained crush Ramachandrappa vs Ramesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20775556/
10 lacerated wound dorsum of right foot and back of heel with fracture of 3 rd Metatarsal.
Further on examination he found that stiffness at ankle noted with inability to dorsiflex beyond 10 degrees inversion and pronation is also restricted.
Further the Petitioner has sustained disability to right lower limb at 20% and whole body disability at 6%.
In support of his oral evidence, the doctor/PW-2 has produced Ex.P-13/IP Record.

In the cross-examination of PW-2 by the counsel for Respondent No.2 he has deposed prior to admission to his hospital the Petitioner has taken treatment in other hospital and he has not gone through the treatment given to the Petitioner in that hospital.
He is the treated doctor of the Petitioner.
The Petitioner has sustained fracture in the 3 rd finger of his right foot and he was operated and inserted K-wire therein.
The fracture in right leg is united.
Further he has denied that the Petitioner is hale and healthy and he is not suffering from pain and difficulties.

Further he denied that in order to help the petitioner he has M.V.C.No.913/2021 28 SCCH - 7 assessed disability on the higher side and filed false evidence affidavit and deposing falsely.
30.

As the occupation of the petitioner is considered as working at agriculturist and mild vending while doing such work the petitioner has to stand and sit for long time, he has to bend, put weight on both legs, he has to sit down while doing the work and he has to walk and he has climb upstairs and downstairs.
But due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident the petitioner has not in position to do work as past.
The doctor has assessed the disability left upper limb at 20% and total whole body disability at 6%.
Hence by considering the age, occupation, nature of injury and the functional disability of the petitioner is considered as 6% to the whole body.
31. With regard to the quantum, the age of the petitioner is considered as 55 years and the income is considered at Rs.13,250/- p.m.
As per Sarala Varma's Case the multiplier 11 is applicable and functional disability is considered at 6%.
On considering the avocation and age of the petitioner, the total loss of future income is calculated as (Rs.13,250/- X 12 X 11 X 6/100) = Rs.1,04,940/-.

Hence,
an amount of Rs.1,04,940/- is M.V.C.No.913/2021 29 SCCH - 7 awarded to the petitioner under the head loss of future income for the disability suffered by him in the accident.

32. In the alleged accident the petitioner has sustained left olecranon fracture and radial head fracture and the Petitioner has undergone ORIF of metatarsal using IM K-pin, which shows that definitely the petitioner has suffered pain due to the injuries sustained in the accident, hence an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is awarded towards pain and suffering, mental agony.

33. Further due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has taken treatment as an inpatient at Raj Mahal Vilas Hospital for a period from 01.03.2019 to 06.03.2019, i.e., for a period of 6 days.
Therefore this court deems it appropriate to award Rs.18,000/- (Rs.3,000/- per day X 6 days) under head of special diet and conveyance.
34. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has suffered uncomfortable in his day to day life, hence an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is awarded towards loss of amenities.

35. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the Petitioner would require atleast six months period to recuperate and to get back to his normal day to day M.V.C.No.913/2021 30 SCCH - 7 activities.
Therefore the Petitioner would be entitled to Rs.79,500/- (Rs.13,250/- x 6 months) under Ramachandrappa vs Ramesh on 11 March, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20775556/
11 the head loss of income during laid up period.
36. Further the Petitioner has produced hospital and medical expenses as per Ex.P.7 for an amount of Rs.1,25,665/-.
Hence the petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.1,25,665/- under the head of hospital and medical expenses.

37. The details of compensation I propose to award are as under:
Sl. Compensation under different heads Amount in No. (Rs) 1 Loss of future income due to disability 1,04,940-00 2 Pain and suffering, mental agony 1,00,000-00 3
Special diet and conveyance 18,000-00 4 Loss of amenities 1,00,000-00 5 79,500-00 Loss of income during laid up period 6
Actual medical expenses 1,25,665-00 Total 5,28,105-00 38.

The Petitioners are entitled to a total compensation of Rs.5,28,105/-.
M.V.C.No.913/2021 31 SCCH - 7 39.

The counsel for Respondent No.3/ Insurance Company contended that offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle has not holding valid and effective permit to run in the spot road as on the date of the alleged accident, as such there is clear violation of the terms and conditions of the insurance policy and accordingly the Respondent No.3/ Insurance Company is not liable to pay the award amount.

On perusing the documents and material available on records it is admitted fact that the offending vehicle is duly insured with Respondent No.3/ Insurance Company and the same is in force as on the date of the accident.

In the cross-examination of RW-2/ Respondent No.1 he has specifically contended that he is having valid and effective permit as on the date of the alleged accident and he has produced the same before the police during the investigation.

In this matter though the Respondent No.3 Insurance Company taken contentions that the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle is not having valid and effective permit to run on the spot road as such there is violation of terms and conditions of the insurance policy.

But in this regard the Respondent No.3 / Insurance Company has not taken any pain to produce the existing permit with respect to offending Auto Rickshaw and even the Respondent M.V.C.No.913/2021 32 SCCH - 7 No.3 / Insurance Company has not taken pain to examine the concerned RTO to that extent.

Hence there is no force in the contention of the Respondent No.3/ Insurance Company and accordingly the counsel for Respondent No.1 rightly contended that the ground urged by the Respondent No.3 is untenable.
40. Hence the respondents No.1 and 3 are jointly and severally liable to pay the award amount.
However, the primary liability to pay the compensation amount is fixed on the respondent No.3/Insurance Company and it is directed to deposit the compensation amount.
Thus I conclude that, the Insurance company/Respondent No.3 is directed to deposit the compensation amount along with interest at 6% p.a., from the date of filing of the claim petition.

Hence, I answer issue No.2 and 3 are partly in the affirmative.

opennyai_summary.facts:
1. The petitioner filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act 1989, seeking compensation of Rs.25,00,000/- for the injures sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 01.03.2019.
Accordingly, a case was registered in their Crime No.25/2019 and prepared F.I.R. for the offence punishable under sections 279, M.V.C.No.913/2021 4 SCCH - 7 337 &
338 of IPC and submitted to the jurisdictional judicial Magistrate and the superior officers and investigation was taken up by the investigating Officer.
3.
Due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident he has lost his income and future prospective life, happiness, and earning capacity and become disabled and dependent.
The alleged accident is occurred due to fault and negligence act of the driver of the offending Auto bearing Reg.No.KA-05-AD-0643 and driver of bus KA-57-F-2882.
opennyai_summary.issue:
:: I S S U E S ::
(1) Whether the Petitioner proves that the accident occurred due to rash and negligent act of driving of Auto Rickshaw bearing Reg.No.KA-05-AD- 0643 and as a result, he sustained injuries?
(2) Whether the petitioner proves the age and earnings of the petitioners as stated in the claim petition?
(3) Whether petitioner is entitled for compensation?
If so, what is the quantum? from whom?
( 4 ) What order or award?
Issue No.1 :- In the affirmative  Issue No.2 :- Partly in the affirmative  Issue No.3 :- Partly in the affirmative  Issue No.4 :- As per final order,

opennyai_summary.arguments:
The Respondent No.1 has admitted that he is the RC owner of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle and his version is that, he is possessing valid and effective driving licence, permit and the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle was duly insured with Respondent No.3/Insurance company and any liability, i.e., fastened on him would have to be indemnify by the Respondent No.3 and sought for dismissal of the claim petition.
The Respondent No.3 has admitted that it is the RC owner of the unoffending M.V.C.No.913/2021 10 SCCH - 7 BMTC Bus bearing registration No.KA-57-F-2882 and its version is that alleged accident occurred due to negligence and fault on the part of the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw himself and there is no such negligence or fault on the part of the driver of the said unoffending BMTC bus, as such Respondent No.2 is not liable to pay any compensation to the petitioner.
The Respondent No.3/Insurance Company admitted the alleged accident and the offending vehicle was duly insured with it and its version is that, the alleged accident occurred due to the negligence and fault of the unoffending BMTC Bus and no fault of the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle, however, slowly he may be driving and therefore he cannot be held to be negligent.
Further it is alleged that the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle is not possessing valid DL and effective permit at the time of alleged accident.
Hence there is violation of the terms M.V.C.No.913/2021 11 SCCH - 7 and conditions of the insurance policy.
As such the insurance company is not liable to pay any compensation and in order to obtained compensation the Petitioner has constrained to filed the present claim petition.
Further it is denied that the age, income and occupation of the Petitioner and the petition is false and frivolous in the eye of law and the quantum of compensation claimed by the claimant is exorbitant and sought for dismissal of the petition.
The counsel for Respondent No.1 claimed the said Respondent No.1/ accused is to be innocent and further the counsel for Respondent No.2 contended that, the alleged accident occurred due to fault of the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw and no fault of the driver of the unoffending M.V.C.No.913/2021 23 SCCH - 7 BMTC Bus.
As such the Petitioner is entitled for compensation under the head of pain and suffering, mental agony, medical expenses, special diet, conveyance, loss of future income due to disability, loss of amenities and loss of income during laid up period and prays to award the compensation as prayed in the petition.
Since the Petitioner has not established his income, he is not entitled for compensation towards such prospects and hence prays dismissal of the petition.
Hence it is clear that as on the date of the accident the Petitioner was aged about 55 years.
Hence the age of the Petitioner is considered as 55 years.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The accident occurred due to the negligence of the driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle.
The alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle and fault of the accused.
Therefore, considering the above discussed aspects collectively, it is the considered opinion of the Court that, the incident having been taken place in the M.V.C.No.913/2021 24 SCCH - 7 manner asserted by the prosecution and the same being proved to have been taken place in the manner alleged by the prosecution, the accused drew the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle in a rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and at the spot dashed to the unoffending BMTC Bus and unoffending Motor Cycle vehicle, as a result the Petitioner/rider of the unoffending Motor Cycle sustained grievous injuries.
Because, for the above reasons collectively it is clear that, the accident happened due to rash and negligent act of the accused.
It is evident that injuries noted in the Ex.P5/Wound Certificate would be caused by a road accident.
At the same time, it has come out in evidence that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle and fault of the accused.
Matters being so, the acts of the accused person clearly constitute the offences punishable under sections 279, M.V.C.No.913/2021 25 SCCH - 7 337 and 338 of IPC.
Thus because of such negligent act of the accused/driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle, it resulted in the injuries of the innocent man/Petitioner aforesaid, as he/accused drove the said offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle very rashly or negligently on the spot.
Therefore, the alleged accident occurred due to the fault of the accused/driver of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle.
28. It is not in dispute that the Petitioner sustained injuries in the road traffic accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending Auto Rickshaw vehicle by its driver/accused.
In the instance case the petitioner claimed that he was working as Farmer and Milk Vendor and earning an income of more than Rs.30,000/- p.m., But he has not produced any documents to prove his actual income.
In the absence of proof of income the notional income as to be assessed.
